transcriber_notes: Photo of a handwritten field book, rotated 90 degrees; read rotated upright (EXIF-corrected original, 3264x2448). Heights are written numbers. Temperature at 200 cm written '-5.7' with the last digit crossed/overwritten (7 with a bar, or a correction); H rows 60, 40, 20, 0 have no temperatures. Bottom layer (70 cm down) is written on the footer line with no bottom height, so bottom_cm is null. The +r row at 227 was treated as a surface description because a second +r row with hardness F follows before the 224 line.
